headline: Pomina to receive up to VND 1,352 billion in capital support; KAFI plans to raise VND 500 billion through bonds
summary: Vinhomes will provide working capital of up to VND 1,352 billion to the Pomina Steel group. KAFI Securities plans to issue VND 500 billion in bonds to restructure debts.
why: Vinhomes is a major Vietnamese property developer, and capital support to a steel group signals intra-group financing and restructuring. Investors monitor such deals for corporate balance-sheet effects in Vietnam.

original_headline: Pomina được hỗ trợ vốn tối đa 1.352 tỷ đồng, KAFI lên kế hoạch huy động 500 tỷ đồng trái phiếu
